name: research-literature
description: Search, organize, and analyze current research literature for mechanical fault diagnosis and deep learning.

interface.longDescription: Search multilingual scholarly sources, locate legal open-access copies, organize evidence, compare fault-diagnosis methods, and connect papers to code and datasets.
defaultPrompt: Use $research-literature to find recent bearing fault diagnosis papers.
Use $research-literature to compare deep learning methods and datasets.
Use $research-literature to build an evidence table for a systematic review.
